explanations: search() pasted the user's text into the SQL string with an f-string, so quotes in the text change the statement: an apostrophe breaks it, and ' OR '1'='1 or a UNION clause rewrites it. The sort column is safe because it is looked up in a whitelist, but values must never be interpolated. The fix keeps a ? placeholder in the SQL and passes the wildcard-wrapped text as a bound parameter, so sqlite3 treats it purely as data.
